messages:
maya: quick design question: final pass on form validation for Console > Model Pins. i'm toggling between 3 UX bits: required markers, error placement, and delete confirmations on mobile. TL;DR: want accessible, low-noise, and clear delete flows. thoughts? dan: short take: explicit text for required, summary+inline for errors, typed confirm only for truly destructive actions. mobile needs special handling. sophia: +1 summary+inline. summary should be an assertive live region and receive focus on submit fail. include anchor links that focus the actual input. ensure aria-describedby points to the inline message. oliver: prefer '(required)' text after the label for clarity. asterisk + color is ambiguous and fails colorblind readers. also consider short helper text vs persistent label for dense forms. marco: on delete: for single pin delete use a modal with clear primary/secondary buttons. for deletes that remove model artifacts or >8 pins use typed confirm (e.g., type DELETE) and require elevated role. mobile: prefer a one-step confirm with a clear 'Permanently delete' CTA and strong color. maya: what's the reason for threshold 8? open to change but want to avoid accidental bulk wipes. marco: it's a safety heuristic: >8 implies bulk intent; also correlate with API bulk-delete endpoints. dan: little a11y nit: set aria-invalid="true" on invalid inputs and include aria-live updates for the summary. when an anchor link is clicked, call element.focus() then scrollIntoView({block: 'center'}). a11y-bot: WCAG reminder: required indicators must not rely solely on color. error outlines should meet 3:1 contrast for UI components. ensure focus outlines are visible and large-touch targets on mobile. sophia: UX rule idea: if errors > 3, expand the summary and collapse inline microcopy to reduce clutter. otherwise show inline hints below fields. smooth scroll on jump is helpful. oliver: copy suggestion for summary heading: "Please fix the highlighted fields to continue." less alarming than "Errors". for typed confirm text: "Type DELETE to permanently remove this model pin." keep concise. maya: small example i'll add to the spec: ```html

Please fix the highlighted fields to continue

  • Model name is required
``` dan: add data-test-id and data-error-id for analytics, and include a mapping from server error keys to field ids in the spec. maya: ok plan: implement summary+inline anchors, explicit '(required)' markers, typed-confirm for irreversible/bulk deletes, focus summary on desktop and scroll-to-first-inline on mobile, plus WCAG checks. i'll post updated figma + the short front-end spec in ~20m. thanks! :thumbsup:
